transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I was going through old trip notes and laughed at how many times I bounced between Beijing and Shanghai back in 2025.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: At one point I even kept a little list of places in Beijing to stay, just to compare neighborhoods.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And for Shanghai I had this whole food spreadsheet—restaurants, notes, who liked what—kind of ridiculous in hindsight.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Oh, and I remember also jotting down clinics in Shanghai after a coworker got sick—nothing serious, just being cautious.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: For one dinner, my friend handled it and it was already set: Xiao Nan Guo on 2025-03-10 at 19:00.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: That same reservation was for 6 people, and it was under Chen Ming—he used 13867894321 as the contact number.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Later that month we stayed at the Grand Mercure Beijing—check-in was 2025-03-27, for 4 nights, and it was in Chen Ming’s name.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: And the train bit was funny too—Chen Ming had already booked D321 on 2025-03-12, First Class, so we just followed his plan.
